context: Tab completion fails without a config file

checklist.name: hook_runs_for_completion
checklist.description: Explains that the root persistent pre-run hook is skipped for --help and --version but runs for the `completion` command and for every hidden `__complete` request.

checklist.name: fix
checklist.description: Moves config loading into the operations that need it, or returns early from the hook for completion and help commands.

checklist.name: test
checklist.description: Adds a test that runs `__complete` or `completion` through `SetArgs` on a fresh tree with no config and expects success.
